'''Talon Group''' was a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|ATR-6 ''Gamma''-class transports]] that [[Battle of Kothlis|attempted]] to stop the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] evacuation of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]].
